title: PARA Graph Core Architecture
summary: Core architecture of the hybrid code-knowledge graph: node schema (GraphNode with SemanticAttributes), edge schema (GraphEdge with confidence levels), Unified CSA traceability mechanism (bidirectional Code↔Spec/Doc binding), SQLite storage layout (.beads/graph/), Memory Engine (events + semantic slices), Project Insights (lessons/risks/patterns), L2 File Structure safety (snapshots, diff, protected files, session_compact), Junk Governance (profile-driven classification), and Session Telemetry (usage logs and optimization analysis).
